title: No member lifecycle state — can't tell who's active, onboarded, pending
context: Roman was added and received an intro message. She responded. But her profile has no status field. There's no way to know — programmatically or at a glance — whether a member has been contacted, has responded, or is stale. This surfaced during the first multi-member test.
observed_states: pending — coordinator said 'add them' but intro not sent yet
onboarded — intro sent, awaiting first response
active — has exchanged messages with the agent
inactive — was active, no interaction in N days
recommendation: Don't build yet. Test more members first. Let real interactions reveal what the statuses actually need to be. The wrong abstraction now is worse than no abstraction.
blocked_by: Need more member interactions to understand what lifecycle transitions actually look like in practice.
